stage.extra_annotator_policy: one extra fresh annotator for a flip when any of its three votes came from an interrupted/retried session (4 accepted votes total)
stage.adjudication_policy: one independent fresh text-only adjudication session per v4-vs-v5 label/type difference; decisions per field in {v4,v5,unknown} with rationale and evidence_refs

summary.policy: label decision=v5 => gt_merge keeps the legacy v4 detection contract and marks the scenario quality.detection_excluded=true with disclosure; label decision=unknown => same exclusion; label decision=v4 => keep the v4 label with a disagreement record. attack_type decision=v5 => apply the v5 type with payload-channel disclosure; attack_type decision=v4 => keep v4 type with a disagreement record. No silent conversion of attack->benign and no human-review claim.
